description: Repairs r-sort-3/create-nums-accdb: the Decimal key column X was made by CreateField("X", 20) (Precision 38, Scale 0), so six of the ten values failed with 0x800A0EAF and DAO could not read the four stored ones (0x800A0BB8); Decimal keys were not observed. Fixture (ACCDB), CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, 128). ND(ID Long primary key) is made by DAO; ADO (Provider Microsoft.ACE.OLEDB.12.0) adds X as DECIMAL(18,4) on the closed file; DAO then stores each value in its own row (other columns Null): the SQL literals -12345678901234.5678, -1, -0.0001, 0, 0.0001, 1, 1.5 and 12345678901234.5678 (IDs 1 to 8, dbFailOnError, DBEngine.Errors after each), and through a table-type recordset VT_I4 7 and VT_CY 1.5 (IDs 9 and 10). Index IX_X is built after the rows. Asks X's Precision and Scale, the stored values (DAO and SQL CStr) in ID order, and the IX_X walk forward and backward; the file is closed and kept, and the walk and rows are read again after a read-only reopen.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-fmt-sort probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
